question: What is the big round ride at a fair called? 🎡
explanation: Super! A Ferris wheel is a huge round ride that takes you high up in the air! 🎡
hint: It goes round and round in a big circle.

question: Who takes us to the fair? 👪
explanation: Awesome! Going to the fair with our family is the best fun! 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
hint: These are the people you live with.

question: What must we buy to go on a ride? 🎟️
explanation: Great job! We buy a small paper ticket to enjoy the fun rides! 🎟️
hint: We give money at the counter to get this.

question: How should we stand to buy tickets? 🧍‍♂️
explanation: Super! Standing in a straight line makes buying tickets easy and safe! 🚶‍♂️🚶‍♀️

question: What sweet pink treat looks like a cloud? ☁️
explanation: Awesome! Cotton candy melts in your mouth and tastes so sweet! 🍭
hint: It is also called budhi ke baal.

question: Where should we throw empty food packets? 🗑️
explanation: Great job! A good child always throws trash in the dustbin to keep the fair clean! 🗑️
hint: It is a bin for waste.

question: Which animal ride goes round and round? 🎠
explanation: Super! The merry-go-round has wooden horses that go up and down! 🎠

question: Who makes us laugh at the fair? 🤡
explanation: Awesome! The funny clown does silly tricks to make everyone smile! 😂

question: How do we stay safe in the crowd? 🤝
explanation: Great job! Always hold your parents' hands so you don't get lost! 👨‍👧
hint: Keep your fingers tight with mommy or daddy.

question: Who can help if we get lost? 👮
explanation: Super! The police uncle is our friend and keeps us very safe! 🚔

question: What do we pop to win a prize? 🎈
explanation: Awesome! We pop colorful balloons with a toy gun to win cute prizes! 🎯

question: What does a magician show us? 🎩
explanation: Great job! A magician pulls a rabbit out of a hat with his magic! 🐇

question: What loud popping snack do we eat? 🍿
explanation: Super! Hot and salty popcorn is the best snack to eat at the fair! 🌽

question: What moves on a track at the fair? 🚂
explanation: Awesome! The toy train goes 'Choo Choo' on its little tracks! 🛤️

question: What do we do at a puppet show? 🎪
explanation: Great job! Dancing puppets tell us wonderful stories! 🎭
hint: We look at it with open eyes.

question: Who sells bright flying things? 🎈
explanation: Super! The balloon seller has big red, blue, and green balloons! 🎈

question: What hot sweet is round and orange? 🥨
explanation: Awesome! Hot, sweet jalebis are so yummy to eat with family! 😋
hint: It is a twisted Indian sweet.

question: What do we buy from toy stalls? 🧸
explanation: Great job! Toy stalls have soft teddy bears, cars, and dolls! 🚗

question: What shines bright at the fair at night? 💡
explanation: Super! The whole fair glows with bright, colorful fairy lights! ✨

question: How do we feel when we win a game? 😃
explanation: Awesome! Winning a soft toy makes us jump with joy! 🎉

question: What game uses rings to catch toys? ⭕
explanation: Great job! We throw a round ring to win the toy we want! 🎯

question: Before eating food, we must... 🧼
explanation: Super! Clean hands keep the bad germs away so we stay strong! 👐

question: What should we do if it is very crowded? 🚶
explanation: Awesome! Walking slowly keeps everyone safe and happy! 🐢

question: What music do we hear at the fair? 🎵
explanation: Great job! Fun, loud music makes us want to dance! 💃

question: What do we ride that goes up and down? 🎢
explanation: Super! A roller coaster zooms fast and gives us butterflies! 🦋
hint: It goes on a bumpy track.

question: What do we give the shopkeeper for toys? 💵
explanation: Awesome! We pay notes and coins to buy nice things! 🪙

question: Who juggles balls in the air? 🤹
explanation: Great job! The juggler throws many balls up and catches them all! 🎾
hint: He throws rings or balls high.

question: What cold treat is fun to lick? 🍦
explanation: Super! A cold vanilla ice cream is perfect for a fair! 🍧

question: When waiting for our ride, we must be... ⏳
explanation: Awesome! Good children wait patiently for their turn to ride! 🧍‍♀️

question: What keeps us safe on a fast ride? 💺
explanation: Great job! We must always click our seat belt before the ride starts! 🚗

question: What do bumper cars do? 🚗
explanation: Super! Driving and bumping into friends' cars is so much fun! 🚙
hint: They touch each other with a soft crash.

question: What sweet drink is yellow and cold? 🥭
explanation: Awesome! Fresh fruit juice keeps us cool in the crowd! 🥤
hint: It is made of the king of fruits.

question: What should we wear to walk safely? 👟
explanation: Great job! We walk a lot at the fair, so comfy shoes are best! 🥾

question: How do the fair lights look? ✨
explanation: Super! Red, blue, and green lights make the fair look magical! 🌈

question: What happens when the fair closes? ⛺
explanation: Awesome! After a fun day, we go back to our cozy beds! 😴
hint: We go to sleep in our room.

question: What do we bring back from the fair? 🛍️
explanation: Great job! We bring back toys and a heart full of happy memories! ❤️

question: Who drives the toy train? 🚂
explanation: Super! The friendly driver honks the horn and takes us around! 🛤️

question: What tells us a ride is starting? 🔔
explanation: Awesome! The bell rings to tell everyone to hold on tight! 🔔

question: What color is a police uncle's uniform? 👮
explanation: Great job! A smart khaki uniform helps us spot the police uncle quickly! 🚔
hint: It is a shade of brown.

question: What do we do with a newly bought toy? 🧸
explanation: Super! We share and play nicely with our brand new fair toys! 🎲

question: Where are fairs usually set up? 🎪
explanation: Awesome! A huge open ground is perfect for big rides and lots of people! 🏟️

question: What do we see everywhere at the fair? 👀
explanation: Great job! Everyone loves the fair so they have big, happy smiles! 😄

question: What can we buy for our little sister? 🎀
explanation: Super! Gifting a sweet doll makes our little sister very happy! 🎁

question: What do we carry to keep our things safe? 🎒
explanation: Awesome! A bag helps us carry our water bottle and new toys safely! 🎒

question: If we want to ride again, we must... 🎟️
explanation: Great job! Every new turn on a ride needs a new ticket! 🎟️

question: How do we talk to the balloon seller? 🗣️
explanation: Super! We must always use magic words like 'Please' and 'Thank you'! 🙏

question: What fun thing spins fast on our finger? 🌀
explanation: Awesome! A colorful plastic spinner goes round and round on our hand! 🌀

question: What do we do when a magic trick ends? 👏
explanation: Great job! Clapping makes the magician feel very happy and proud! 👏

question: How do we feel after a long day at the fair? 🥱
explanation: Super! Playing all day makes us sleepy, but our hearts are full of joy! 😴
hint: We want to sleep but we are smiling.

question: A fair is a place full of... 🎉
explanation: Awesome! Fairs are magical places made just for fun, smiles, and laughter! ✨
